title: Anchorage footer
description: A black, dense footer: the emblem alone at the left, then five link columns with grey headings, small grey caps for groups and sub-groups and tiny bold links that turn cobalt on hover. Under them a contact table (icon, label, right-aligned values split by a hairline), cobalt social icons, several paragraphs of grey fine print, and a bottom line with the copyright and pipe-separated legal links. Phones stack it all with larger links.
notes: an entry with href is a link; without, it is a group label (level "group") or a smaller sub-label (level "label")
name: anchorage-footer
